Rhymes from Datamuse, the engine behind RhymeZone

# RhymeZone 🎵
Find rhymes for a word from Alfred.
Type `rhy` followed by a word. Results come from the [Datamuse API](https://www.datamuse.com/api/), the engine behind [RhymeZone](https://www.rhymezone.com), best matches first, with syllable counts.
- <kbd>↩</kbd> copy the word - <kbd>⌘</kbd><kbd>L</kbd> show it in Large Type - <kbd>⇧</kbd> or <kbd>⌘</kbd><kbd>Y</kbd> preview the word on RhymeZone
Needs an internet connection; nothing to install.
Written in response to a request on the Alfred Forum: [Workflow for rhymes](https://www.alfredforum.com/topic/22849-workflow-for-rhymes).
